input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-mk1pa171/bench_opencode_trig-list_gwtleyzy && (python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 || python3 -m unittest -q 2>&1) | tail -3; python3 -c "
from miniconf.loader import load; c=load('examples/service.conf'); print(vars(c))"
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir $d/sub; printf 'a=1\n@include sub/b.conf\na=3\n' > $d/a.conf; printf 'a=2\nb=x\n@include c.conf\n' > $d/sub/b.conf; printf 'c=9\n' > $d/sub/c.conf; printf '@include self.conf\n' > $d/self.conf; printf '@include nope.conf\n' > $d/miss.conf
python3 -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
print(vars(load('$d/a.conf')))
for f in ['self','miss']:
    try: load('$d/'+f+'.conf')
    except ConfigError as e: print('ok', e)
"
